goal: Avoid hitting an assertion failure when an orphan transaction already in the mempool is evaluated for relay
Ensures 1P1C package processing skips and removes orphan candidates that entered the mempool via RPC
agreement: Tested on Windows without substantive review rationale (Yudis-bit)
Suggested cleaning orphans proactively on mempool entry rather than during package relay (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes an edge-case assertion failure in debug builds during 1P1C package construction
Only triggers when an orphan enters the mempool via non-peer mechanisms before its parent arrives
